cover: AI proposal terms, defined in plain English

slides.title: Weights
slides.body: The billions of numbers where a model stores what it learned in training. Broad, and it doesn't update when your prices change.

slides.title: Context
slides.body: What you send with each question: instructions, a pasted document, the conversation so far. Read fresh each time, up to a limit.

slides.title: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
slides.body: Searches your documents for the passages that matter and adds them to the context. Change a policy, re-index, and it's current.

slides.title: Embeddings
slides.body: How passages get found by meaning as well as by exact words. RAG's search by meaning usually relies on them.

slides.title: Fine-tuning
slides.body: More training on reviewed input and output examples. It changes the weights, so it's better for format and tone than for changing facts.

slides.title: Baseline prompt
slides.body: Clear instructions plus a few good examples. Try it first: it's often enough, and it's what you measure anything else against.
